scope: Willowmere civic plaza terrain junction closeout

reportedVisualFailure.location: Willowmere central plaza road entrances and outer corners
reportedVisualFailure.symptom: Square owner-fill blocks and broken-looking edges where StonePath touched brown Dirt directly
reportedVisualFailure.rootCause: The source-pure V7 atlas contains complete Stone_Tan-to-Dirt_Tan and Dirt_Tan-to-Dirt_Brown tuples, but contains no Stone_Tan-to-Dirt_Brown tuple. The compact plaza was therefore creating unsupported two- and three-material contacts.

acceptance: Every cardinal neighbor leaving the 11x11 StonePath plaza is Road.
No StonePath plaza cell directly touches brown Dirt, Mud, Sand, or water.
Road approaches merge into the one-tile apron without a second material seam.
The V7 mapped terrain atlas remains unchanged and source-pure.
